name: auryn-http
summary: Language-agnostic HTTP call<->endpoint stitch for Auryn (ADR 0006): a post-ingestion hook that resolves route-keyed APIEndpoint placeholders (emitted by any caller language) to their handler Methods across the shared multi-repo graph, by route and HTTP verb (MVC `/Controller/Action` routes match by name only). Order-independent, 1-to-many, provenance-scoped. Depends only on auryn-core.
